title: Import list should exclude already-imported tickets (prevent duplicate imports)
scope:
# Summary

A ticket that already exists as a card on the SpecKit Pilot board should not be importable again. Already-imported tickets should be filtered out of the Import ticket list so the same ticket can't be imported twice (which creates duplicate cards).

# Steps to Reproduce

1. Open the SpecKit Pilot board.
2. Open the Import ticket modal and import a ticket (creates a card).
3. Open the Import ticket modal again.

Expected: The ticket just imported no longer appears in the import list.
Actual: The already-imported ticket still appears and can be imported again, creating a duplicate card.

# Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The Import ticket list excludes any ticket that already exists as a card on the board (matched by ticket source key)
- [ ] Importing the same ticket twice is not possible via the import list
- [ ] Re-opening the import modal reflects newly-created cards (already-imported tickets disappear)
- [ ] Matching is by stable ticket source key (Linear `identifier` / `Ticket.key`), not by title
- [ ] If every assigned ticket is already imported, the list shows an appropriate empty state

# Dev Hints

* Import list source: `extensions/speckit-pilot/src/renderer/components/ImportTicketModal.tsx` — fetches all assigned tickets via `getSpeckitAPI().ticketList()` with no filtering against existing cards.
* Cross-reference against existing cards via the card-list IPC; filter fetched tickets whose source key matches an existing card's ticket key.
* This is the same dedup concern as the auto-load work in [TAV-11](https://linear.app/andrew-tavares/issue/TAV-11/speckit-pilot-should-auto-load-assigned-tickets-on-open-import-becomes) — consider a shared "which tickets are already cards" helper so both the import list and auto-load reconcile identically.
